name: ReFuels N.V.
summary: ReFuels N.V. specializes in the development, ownership, and management of sustainable refueling infrastructure. Operating under its "CNG Fuels" brand, the company provides environmentally sound alternative fuels, notably renewable biomethane, to heavy-duty vehicles across the United Kingdom through a widespread network of public-access stations. Beyond this, it is also active in the trading of renewable transport fuel certificates. The enterprise was founded in 2014 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
